test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: PQ and RS are common tangents to two circles intersecting at A and B. A and B, when produced on both the sides, meet the tangents PQ and RS at X and Y, respectively. If AB = 3 cm and XY = 5 cm, then PQ is ________.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For two intersecting circles, the length of the common tangent PQ can be directly calculated using the relationship between the extended common chord XY and the inner chord AB.

The extended line bisects the common tangents and the external segments are equal (XA = YB).

Direct formula: **PQ = √(XY² − AB²)**

⇒ PQ = √(5² − 3²)

⇒ PQ = √(25 − 9) = √16 = 4 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of common chord AB = 3 cm

Extended transversal segment XY = 5 cm

**Formula Used:**

Tangent-Secant Theorem: PT² = PA × PB
